introPt: A traveller plans around the closures and finds the sagra.

dialogo.es: Chiuso per ferie dal dieci al venticinque agosto.
dialogo.pt: Closed for holidays from the tenth to the twenty-fifth of August.
dialogo.tts: Chiuso per ferie dal dieci al venticinque agosto.

dialogo.es: Domani è il santo patrono, è festa solo qui.
dialogo.pt: Tomorrow is the patron saint's day, it's a holiday only here.
dialogo.tts: Domani è il santo patrono, è festa solo qui.

dialogo.es: Sabato c'è la sagra del cinghiale, al campo sportivo.
dialogo.pt: Saturday there's the wild boar festival, at the sports ground.
dialogo.tts: Sabato c'è la sagra del cinghiale, al campo sportivo.

dialogo.es: Sì, contanti. Prendi i buoni alla cassa all'ingresso.
dialogo.pt: Yes, cash. You get the tickets at the till by the entrance.
dialogo.tts: Sì, contanti. Prendi i buoni alla cassa all'ingresso.

opcoes: A saint's day in each town
15 August, national holiday and peak of the summer break
perguntas.explica: Cities empty and the coast fills.

perguntas.pergunta: Why can one town be closed and the next open?
opcoes: Each comune has its own patron saint's day
perguntas.explica: Rome 29 June, Milan 7 December, Naples 19 September, Venice 25 April.

opcoes: A village festival built around one ingredient
perguntas.explica: Long tables, one dish, usually the food you will remember.

perguntas.pergunta: How do you pay at a sagra?
opcoes: Usually cash, often via a ticket system
perguntas.explica: The one place where the card rule does not help you.

opcoes: On paper - posters, banners, a sign at the roundabout
perguntas.explica: Which is why you ask a person, not a phone.
